name: 女童太空棉蕾丝裙摆外套款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清外套轮廓与花型，赢取点击且平台合规
一秒传递优雅公主风的核心卖点上，承接点击
代入日常出行与聚会场景，让家长想象孩子穿上后的样子
并列展示深浅两个配色，让买家快速选定颜色
微距证明蕾丝花型的立体质感与面料层次
特写领口走线与胸前装饰位，证明做工精致
侧面特写裙摆波浪剪裁，突出版型层次与垂感
俯视平铺加量线标注，消除尺码是否合身的疑虑
展示内里平整顺滑，降低家长对穿着舒适度的顾虑
用干净的图标识与留白参数位承接信任，信息留待后期填充
裙摆扬起的轻盈画面收口，留出按钮位促成下单

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF studio for packshot and infographic shots, blush pink #F4E6E3 paneled wall for display and detail shots, warm ivory interior for lifestyle scenes
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single teal accent #2E9E82
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, airy low-contrast mood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet princess kids outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of lace black #1F1B20, clean white #FFFFFF, blush pink #F4E6E3 and one teal accent #2E9E82; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end children garment photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable straight-on and slight 3/4 garment angles, consistent garment scale and centering across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte blush-pink wall panel, light wood mannequin stand, soft ivory upholstery and matte light boards
